dedupe_keys.name: a dataset of seismic and ambient vibrations from a 4 story building in bucharest romania capturing the 10 largest vrancea earthquakes ml 4 0 4 4 of 2025

description: A Dataset of Seismic and Ambient Vibrations from a 4-Story Building in Bucharest, Romania, Capturing the 10 Largest Vrancea Earthquakes (ML 4.0–4.4) of 2025 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Iolanda-Gabriela Craifaleanu, Claudiu Sorin Dragomir (Technical University of Civil Engineering of Bucharest). FDSN Network ID: RQ, BTH station, miniSEED format, raw. Recorded by the National Network for Seismic Monitoring and Protection of Building Stock (RNMPSPC I.O.S.I.N.), a department of the National Institute for Research and Development in Urban Planning and Sustainable Territorial Development URBAN-INCERC, Romania (https://incd.ro/reteaua-nationala-de-monitorizare-siprotectie-seismica-a-patrimoniului-construit-iosin/#). Coverage: national (RO); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 3 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
